body:
## Why
Portability is the point. Copilot CLI is included in Copilot Free; its local profile is Tier A in the design.

## What
- Built-in profile `copilot-cli` in `src/board.js`: `copilot -p "{prompt}" --agent=kanban-worker --allow-tool='shell(hkb *)' --allow-tool='shell(git *)' --allow-tool='shell(gh pr *)'` run in a worktree the dispatcher creates with `git worktree add .claude/worktrees/kb-{n}-{k} -b kb-{n}-{k}` (Copilot has no --worktree flag).
- `hkb init --harness copilot` generates from templates: `.github/agents/kanban-worker.agent.md` (same protocol text as SKILL.md) and `.github/hooks/kanban.json` with an `agentStop` hook that calls `hkb hook stop` and returns `decision: block` (max 2 nudges).
- `hkb hook stop` must accept Copilot's hook input shape as well as Claude's; document the differences in `src/hook.js`.
- Verify flag names against https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/reference/copilot-cli-reference/cli-programmatic-reference and the hooks reference; if a flag differs, follow the docs and note it in the PR.

## Done when
`hkb init --harness copilot` on a scratch dir produces the files; `hkb doctor` reports the profile; tests for template generation.
title: copilot-cli profile: launch template, .github/agents/kanban-worker.agent.md, agentStop hook via hkb init --harness copilot
